notes.title: The Finale Update
notes.notes:
It's been a long time coming, but Gnomes and Co is finally complete!
With the addition of the final, most devious chapter, the game now has 50 levels as planned.

Also, I've been getting feedback that people are having trouble getting to grips with the game, so now each level in the first chapter has a "hint" solution. Click the "hint" button on the solution screen to see a solution that uses an advanced technique and almost, but not quite, achieves the challenge target.

Moreover, you can now save your solutions as GIF files and share them with other players; just click the "Save GIF" button on the solution screen.

That's all for now! Thank you all for playing Gnomes, and enjoy this final installment!
